packages.description: Explore the tea factory and enjoy the breathtaking views at Mattupetty Dam and Echo Point. If you're looking for a relaxing experience, consider boating at Kundala Dam or visiting the top station of Eravikulam National Park.

packages.title: Munnar to Alapuzha with Sedan Car
packages.description: Erutte Alleppey offers a visual treat with breathtaking waterfalls, lush pineapple plantations, and expansive rubber plantations, all of which can be explored through various Kerala tour packages.

packages.title: Kerala Tour Package
packages.description: Kerala, a stunning state on India's tropical Malabar Coast, boasts nearly 600km of beautiful Arabian Sea shoreline. Known for its palm-lined beaches and picturesque backwaters, which form a unique network of canals, Kerala is a top destination for travelers.
